commands: Vertical Mixing Model == ${vertical_mixing_model}                                        ! {Constant} | Parametric | K-Epsilon | K-Omega | External
Vertical Mixing Parameters == ${vertical_mixing_params}                                  ! {5/9} alpha, {3/40} beta, {9/100} cmu, {2.} sig_k, {2.} sig_o, {0.} c3oplus, {0.} c3ominus
Global Vertical Eddy Viscosity Limits == ${glob_vert_eddy_visc_lims}                     ! {0.0} Minimum eddy viscosity (m^2/s), {99999.} Maximum eddy viscosity (m^2/s)
Global Vertical Scalar Diffusivity Limits == ${glob_vert_scalar_diff_lims}               ! {0.0} Minimum scalar diffusivity (m^2/s), {99999.} Maximum scalar diffusivity (m^2/s)
Global Vertical TKE Limit == ${glob_vert_tke_lim}                                        ! {1E-10 m^2/s^2} Minimum turbulent kinetic energy
Global Vertical EPS Limit == ${glob_vert_eps_lim}                                        ! {1E-14 m^2/s^3} Minimum dissipation rate
Second Order Vertical Mixing Model == ${second_order_vert_mixing_model}                  ! {OFF} | Algebraic
Second Order Vertical Mixing Model Parameter Group == ${second_order_vert_mixing_param_group}  ! {GL78} | MY86 | KC94 | LDOR96 | CHCD01A | CHCD01B | CCH02
Surface Sigma Layers == ${nsigma_layers}                                                 ! {1} Number of sigma layers between uppermost Z layer and water surface level
Min Bottom Layer Thickness == ${min_bottom_thickness}                                    ! {1.e-6} Sets a minimum allowable bottom layer thickness(m)
Cell 3D Depth == ${cell_3d_depth}                                                        ! {0.1} Disable 3D momentum flux below this threshold (m)
